questions.q: In "Washing, wear and durability Analyse", which of these is a key idea?
o: Dry electrodes need skin contact; loose fabric loses signal, and very tight fabric is uncomfortable. Aim for firm but not tight.
Use a small rechargeable cell with a protection circuit and charge only with the right charger. Never use a damaged cell next to skin.
Test cycles: gentle cold wash, air dry. Count cycles to failure.
